analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (112,400 KRW) vs SMA5 (108,766 KRW) / SMA20 (107,618 KRW) / SMA50 (109,215 KRW): Confirms short-to-mid-term uptrend position.
· Position relative to SMA100 (115,180 KRW) / SMA200 (93,578 KRW): Mixed mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (62.9%) + current price level is historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.7→56.1): Confirms exit from oversold and entry into neutral territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (554.6440→876.0886): Signal of continued bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band 107,618 KRW): Bandwidth at 10.11% indicates normal levels.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (110,565 KRW): Based on pivot (109,295 KRW) and SMA20.
· Swing resistance (115,020 KRW): Potential for new 52-week high on breakout.
· 5-day / 20-day high/low pattern: Confirms initiation of Higher Low recovery.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.98x): Normal confidence level for price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: Attempting to rise within accumulation phase; buy entry condition met with support at 110,565 KRW secured.
